sentences.text: My name is Emili. In this podcast, we speak very slowly. We use easy English. We repeat important words.
Today we travel to Asia. We go to Iran. Our city today is Yazd. Yazd is old. Yazd is quiet. Yazd is full of history and desert life.
Please relax. Please listen slowly. Let's begin our journey.
Part two, Iran and Asia. Iran is a country in western Asia. It has a long history. It has many cultures.
Iran has mountains. Iran has deserts. Iran has old cities. People know Tehran and Isfahan.
But today we visit Yazd. Yazd is different. Yazd is calm. Yazd is very special.
Part three, where is Yazd? Yazd is in the center of Iran. It is in a desert area.
There are no seas near Yazd. There are no big rivers. The city is surrounded by sand.
The land is dry. Because of this, people in Yazd learn to live with little water. Part four,
weather and climate. Yazd is a hot city. The sun is strong. In summer, it is very hot.
In winter, it can be cold at night. Rain is rare. Water is precious. People rest during hot hours.
Life moves slowly. The climate shapes daily life. Part five, an ancient city. Yazd is one of the
oldest cities in Iran. People lived here many centuries ago. The city was on old trade routes.
Travelers passed through Yazd. Houses are made of mud bricks. These houses keep the air cool.
History is everywhere. The city feels timeless.
Part six, windcatchers. Badgers. Yazd is famous for windcatchers. In Persian, they are called badgers.
Windcatchers are tall towers. They catch the wind. They bring cool air into houses.
They help people survive the heat. These towers are smart and beautiful. They show human creativity.
Part seven, old streets and houses. The old city of Yazd has narrow streets. The streets are quiet.
The walls are high. The colors are soft and earthy. People walk slowly.
The sound is low. Walking here feels peaceful. It feels like the past is alive.
Part eight, religion and culture. Yazd is important for Zoroastrian culture. Zoroastrianism is an
ancient religion. There are fire temples in Yazd. Fire is sacred. People respect different beliefs.
Culture is calm and respectful. Traditions are strong. History lives in daily life.
Part nine, daily life in Yazd. Daily life in Yazd is simple. People wake up early.
They work in the morning. They rest in the afternoon. In the evening, people meet. They talk
and drink tea. Life is not fast. Life is quiet and steady. Part ten, food in Yazd. Food in Yazd
is traditional. People use rice, bread and vegetables. Sweets are very famous. People love
desserts. Food is shared with family. Meals are moments of connection. Eating together is important.
Food brings warmth. Part eleven, desert and silence. The desert is near Yazd. It is wide
and quiet. At night the sky is clear. You can see many stars. The silence is deep.
The air feels clean. People feel close to nature. The desert teaches patience.
Part twelve, feeling, spirit and goodbye. Yazd is a city of desert, wind, history and quiet life.
